findings: F1 (bounded tolerance, by design): a non-target row differing from its reference by exactly one substituted character is accepted (probe X2b: 分享相片 accepted). This is the deliberate, documented single-glyph tolerance; >=2 substitutions or any length change still refuse (P3/P4), so the residual wrong-menu class is 'nearly identical menu' and is explicitly acknowledged in the plan.

F2 (inherited containment semantics): target identity is exact-substring containment on the CJK-only row text, so a row containing 儲存全部 with extra glyphs (e.g. 儲存全部相簿) would be accepted as the target row (probe X3c). Same containment semantics as frozen v7; no substitution/insertion/deletion of CJK characters in the target is ever accepted; no such item exists in the observed LINE menu.

F3 (v8-only, narrow normalization): non-CJK characters are stripped before matching, so OCR punctuation noise inside the target occurrence no longer causes refusal (probe Q2: 儲存全.部 -> ELIGIBLE). This widening vs v7 is limited to non-CJK noise and cannot admit a substituted/truncated CJK target; it aligns with the observed noise class (選擇項目-, 刪除相簿t).

F4 (reproducibility nuance, not a defect): the output JSON echoes input path strings, so byte-identity requires identical argv strings; my re-runs used the replay builder's argv forms and matched byte-for-byte, while a repo-relative geometry arg yields semantically identical but byte-different JSON.

F5 (minor documentation inconsistency, non-blocking): attempt-01/locator-freeze.json states refusal_cases 25, while results.json reports refusal_cases 2 (refusal-class count) with 36 refusal-verdict cases (43-case bound version: 7 eligible; 44-case post-freeze version: 8 eligible); substantive claims (all pass, 9/9 globals, eligible sets) agree, so the 25 counter should be read as a stale summary field.

F6 (freeze invalidation, drives the gate): during this review a concurrent post-freeze modification replaced run_selftest.py and results.json on disk (c94fc407.../943f2939... -> 0dde65b3ef7687660b46b6eb7f4de869ec0b0dbc28c4928e440427192705a7ee/c83e2ed6654164d63e0a0c163d3d69d37fcbfed4dc74a92cbda1c76682da1116, mtimes 09:43:55/09:44:18), added fixture geo-a05-injected-history.json (842cb93330e3183cf5c3cc7cd28e69b5714084499aa994f49cdc93d7fa2f3418, decoy historical coordinates, new case c19-historical-coordinate-injection, results now 44/44 + 9/9) and rewrote fixtures/ + out/. The plan file and freeze record still bind the old SHAs; per the round's freeze rule the rev27c-1 freeze is invalidated, the plan's approval precondition (bound selftest SHAs on disk) fails, and a new plan revision (rev27c-2) re-binding the new artifact set after a fresh freeze + fresh independent reviews is required. This reviewer made no repo writes outside the two review files and performed no restoration; the unchanged locator c5ad... and the design analysis here remain valid inputs to the next review cycle, not approvals.
residual_risks: R1: a hypothetical menu with the same five-row shape, exact 儲存全部 at the middle, and every non-target row within 1 substituted glyph would pass; no formal proof such a menu cannot exist; bounded by the 1-glyph window rule plus the outside live-route gates (single-ellipsis provenance, baseline tripwire, at-most-once dispatch, post-click observation).

R2: target containment semantics accept a middle-row item that merely contains 儲存全部 (no CJK substitution tolerated); inherited from v7; not observed in the real menu; constrained by the exact five-row neighbor structure and middle position.
R3: non-CJK stripping inside the target occurrence is a narrow widening vs v7; can never admit a wrong CJK glyph sequence.

R4: offline ELIGIBLE confers no live authority; the attempt-05 menu may not persist; any future live round must re-derive fresh evidence under a new owner authorization citing Rev27c + the v8 SHA (menu-persistence rule).
R5: byte-identity across differently-invoked runs is not guaranteed (path strings echoed); determinism holds per fixed inputs/argv.

R6: not re-verified in this review (out of scope or deliberately not re-run): the accepted-baseline digest (57 files / 17,924,900 bytes) and the 'selftest ran twice, results.json byte-identical' claim; per-case determinism (43/43) and my own x2 CLI reruns support them; git status shows no tracked modifications.
R7: unknown future OCR variation beyond the modeled classes is covered only by the bounded tolerance design; anything outside it refuses (conservative direction).

R8: the post-freeze concurrent modification (F6) leaves the repository state inconsistent with the plan and freeze bindings; no future live authorization may cite Rev27c or the old SHAs until a new plan revision re-binds the current bytes after a fresh freeze + fresh reviews.
